title: Do2Earn Off-Page SEO Checklist
description: External authority and promotion checks. These checks require independent evidence and are never marked PASS from source-code inspection alone.

evidencePolicy.passRequires: A verifiable external source, connected webmaster/SEO data provider, or documented evidence supplied for review.
evidencePolicy.note: Public source-code scans cannot measure the full backlink profile, link quality, brand mentions, PR coverage, social engagement, guest posts, or directory authority.

checks.title: Relevant referring domains
checks.description: Verify referring domains and backlink growth using a backlink index or webmaster data.
checks.evidence: Requires Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, Moz, or equivalent backlink data.

checks.title: Backlink relevance and quality
checks.description: Review topical relevance, placement, destination, link attributes and signs of manipulation.
checks.evidence: Requires inspection of actual referring pages and link-level data.

checks.title: Digital PR and editorial coverage
checks.description: Verify genuine editorial coverage and relevant publications mentioning or linking to the project.
checks.evidence: Requires verifiable publication URLs and manual quality review.

checks.title: Unlinked and linked brand mentions
checks.description: Find and review mentions of the project and brand across independent websites.
checks.evidence: Requires web monitoring or search data; search snippets alone are incomplete.

checks.title: Relevant social profiles and activity
checks.description: Review official profiles, consistency, relevant posts and genuine engagement.
checks.evidence: Requires verified profile URLs and platform-level evidence.

checks.title: Relevant community participation
checks.description: Review helpful participation in relevant communities without spam or manipulative link drops.
checks.evidence: Requires community URLs and contextual manual review.

checks.title: Relevant guest articles
checks.description: Verify editorial contributions on relevant, reputable websites and the context of any links.
checks.evidence: Requires published article URLs and editorial quality review.

checks.title: Relevant directories and specialist listings
checks.description: Verify accurate listings in reputable, relevant directories or specialist platforms.
checks.evidence: Requires live listing URLs and relevance/quality review.

checks.title: Backlink monitoring and lost-link review
checks.description: Check new/lost links, broken backlinks, suspicious patterns and disavow decisions where appropriate.
checks.evidence: Requires historical backlink data and periodic human review.
